conventions.uv: [u0, v0, u1, v1] (Blender/Unity UV, origin bottom-left)
conventions.BaseColor: sRGB RGBA8, alpha = coverage (cut 0.45), RGB flooded into alpha 0 per cell (>= 2 px, whole cell)
conventions.Normal: tangent space OpenGL Y+ (Unity normal map as-is)
conventions.ORM: R AO, G roughness 0.80-0.92, B translucency (flat per zone; shader weights upper 50 % by vc1 R)
conventions.unity_import: BaseColor: sRGB, Mip Maps Preserve Coverage ON (cutoff 0.45), aniso 4, mip bias 0; Normal: Normal map; ORM: sRGB off
conventions.px_per_m: texels per metre of real size (cell resolution)
conventions.pivot_uv: attachment point (petiole / stem top / culm top / leaf base)
conventions.profile: frond/leaf cells: per texel row from the root, conservative [u_min, u_max] (mesh card edges)
conventions.moss outline: metres around the pivot; mesh rings outer (z 0, alpha 0), middle (8 cm in, z 0.006), inner (0.45 r) + centre; planar UV = uv_center + (x, y) * px_per_m / 2048
